note: Single source of truth for evidence levels in rational-design-advanced annotations/v2. Aligns with rules/05-evidence-provenance.md: direct observation and author interpretation map to kinds source_evidence/expert_opinion; computational inference maps to dynamics/electronic_structure/evolutionary/zero_shot. Status-level consistency is enforced by validate-annotations for schema v2.

experimental.label: Experimental observation
experimental.note: Direct assay, kinetics, or structure determination (e.g., activity table, Tm, crystal structure).

structural_biochemistry.label: Structural biochemistry
structural_biochemistry.note: Catalytic geometry, PLIP contacts, pocket analysis derived from a validated structure.

dynamics.label: Molecular dynamics
dynamics.note: OpenMM MD ensembles: RMSF, contact occupancy, pocket dynamics.

electronic_structure.label: Electronic structure (QM/MM)
electronic_structure.note: CP2K QM/MM transition states and barriers.

expert_opinion.label: Expert / literature interpretation
expert_opinion.note: Reported mutations or domain judgement; kind is source_evidence for a direct report, hypothesis for interpretation.

status_rule.support: at least one direct level (experimental/structural_biochemistry), or at least two distinct computational levels
status_rule.conditional: at least one evidence item with a level
status_rule.insufficient_evidence: no leveled evidence required (absence of support)
status_rule.conflict: requires non-empty counterevidence_or_risk on at least one decision card
